short_explanation: Treatment: randomized treatment assignment with cleaned-data arms: Alert; Usual Care. Publication-designated control/reference: Usual Care.
Primary outcome: Composite event. Publication-defined endpoint context: Composite of AKI progression (to a higher KDIGO stage), receipt of dialysis, or death within 14 days of randomization.
Primary outcome: Composite time. Publication-defined endpoint context: Composite of AKI progression (to a higher KDIGO stage), receipt of dialysis, or death within 14 days of randomization.
Secondary outcome: Length of stay since alert.
Baseline covariate: Blood urea nitrogen concentration.
Baseline covariate: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
Baseline covariate: Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score.
